fit_models.2: DC+linear trend+sin/cos fundamental and second harmonic; requested primary decomposition
fit_models.3: Same model plus third harmonic, to quantify spectral leakage sensitivity over only 2.248 lift cycles

harmonic_definition: Complex amplitude = cos coefficient - i sin coefficient; area-weighted norm is sqrt(sum area*|C|^2 / sum area). Coherent projection is <C_input,C_ref>/||C_ref||^2, with positive phase indicating lead; spatial coherence is its normalized complex inner-product magnitude. Gt=P_t(J n), the normal derivative of tangential velocity.

normal_velocity.component_energy_scope: The finite-window DC/trend/harmonic basis is not orthogonal, so component energies do not sum to actual difference energy.

tangential_gradient.component_energy_scope: The finite-window DC/trend/harmonic basis is not orthogonal, so component energies do not sum to actual difference energy.

velocity.component_energy_scope: The finite-window DC/trend/harmonic basis is not orthogonal, so component energies do not sum to actual difference energy.

interpretation: These are direct measured input differences. The paired full/crop forced FVM response is correlated with the complete measured difference, not uniquely with its second harmonic.

The primary two-harmonic fit is accompanied by a third-harmonic sensitivity fit because only 2.248 lift cycles are available; individual low-amplitude upstream or second-harmonic differences are susceptible to leakage and trend separation.

A component control would hold DC/trend and every other input identical while substituting only the paired fundamental, or only the paired second harmonic; without it a second-harmonic-only drag cause is unsupported.
The reference image is independently rebuilt from the mature reference each frame. No conclusion here identifies autonomous production VPM evolution as equivalent to this diagnostic.

direct_input_findings.global_normal_velocity_second_harmonic: Both support images have essentially the same global 2f amplitude and phase relative to reference (two-mode fit ratios 1.014649 crop / 1.014634 full; phases -0.62324 / -0.62427 degrees). This does not support a uniquely attenuated input second harmonic as the paired Cd mechanism.
direct_input_findings.side_normal_velocity_fundamental: Combined side-face coherent gain is 0.94040 at -3.590 degrees for crop versus 0.99279 at +1.019 degrees for full. Orthogonal spatial error is 13.04% of reference amplitude versus 1.46%. Global amplitude norm alone conceals this spatial change.
direct_input_findings.mean_input_difference: Full-minus-crop Un DC RMS is 0.001607 globally and 0.000410 on sides, with zero signed global flux; signed side/downstream/upstream area means are +0.000399/-0.002810/+0.001824.
direct_input_findings.leakage_sensitivity: Adding the third harmonic reduces paired global 2f Un difference from 5.76e-5 to 1.99e-5 and side 2f difference from 7.31e-5 to 1.06e-5; fundamental and DC remain stable. This bounds interpretation of the small second-harmonic difference over only 2.248 cycles.
direct_input_findings.force_causality_scope: The completed paired force control measures the response to the entire support-induced input change. A unique fundamental, DC, or second-harmonic cause remains unisolated without a component control.
